dict.string: MyBar uses system audio access only when you adjust an individual app's volume or route it to a separate output device.
MyBar uses media app automation only when you press a Play/Pause control.
Mood Compass optionally reads event times to estimate upcoming workload on this Mac. It never saves event titles or edits your calendars.
Mood Compass optionally counts today's completed and due reminders for local workload estimates. It never saves reminder text or modifies tasks.
Mood Compass optionally uses a coarse location fix to estimate daylight locally. Coordinates are never saved or uploaded.
